entry_admission_input_domain.selected_ecu: model.commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId, snapshotted by confirmSupport to ecuId/ecuNameId/name/phaseType/busId
entry_admission_input_domain.admission: Shell catalog/module-loading permission belongs MenuShell; actual support is successful startGeneralComm->modeA8 opt1->checkA8SupportByBit idCC byte0/all16 FF bit masks->endGeneralComm. No support result body field is read.
entry_admission_input_domain.displayed_precondition: English r_item_i1880 asks engine/power switch ON with engineOFF/ReadyOFF. This is displayed instruction; worker does not read ignition or enforce it separately.

state_fields.scope: confirmSupport resets worker cache; Back/showInitView does not.

guarded_ordered_transitions: init support and best-effort stale-file discovery/purge -> initial view
Next -> VIN then selected ECU21CC serial -> information table or error/VIN-exit dialog
Information Back -> initial view; Information Next -> cancelable loader -> serial service
Service comm error -> error dialog plus initial view; service error -> retry yes/no; success -> complete -> Exit menu
Cancel button pauses return-value delivery via100ms recursive check while service may continue; Yes sets cancel flag and returns menu; No unpauses and restores busy dialog

serial.positive_payload: response.apiArgs.resBody.slice(2), first16 bytes consumed; no explicit length validation; append to cache SerialNumberData

sendDigitalKeyVehicleInfo.TerminalInfo: LicenseKey=shipped fixed zero literal; no account lookup
DigitalkeyVehicleInfo.Document: BleSerialNumber1..3 uppercase unpadded hex BigInt strings;4 and5 empty strings
b0..b15 are cache.vehicleInfo.SerialNumberData[0..15], not parsed display string; no input trimming/length validation before BigInt conversion.
A.retry_as_shipped: Each transmit call creates A={}; when cache.isWebServiceRetry true, makeDataA is skipped and POST uses {}.

response_error_mapping.send: Only commonResult.statusCode===MIR2000000 captures apiResult.ID; all other codes and rejection set service error+retry. No ID existence guard.
response_error_mapping.poll: First poll delayed1000ms; MIR2000000 requires apiResult.ResponseCode exactly string200; MIR2020000 recurses while Date.now-START_TIME<300000, otherwise service error+retry; other status/transport failure service error+retry.
response_error_mapping.local_errors: Software/version/settings rejection sets isComError/detailCode and skips later stages; file write/delete are best effort; unexpected exception rejects unchanged.
response_error_mapping.asynchronous_controller: Dialog helpers do not return buttonPressed promises; confirmSupport error and WebService comm-error presentation can be followed immediately by navigation.

user_visible_result.title: r_item_i1883
user_visible_result.activity: logForTitle r_item_i1883 on init; logForText r_item_i1923 on complete exit

Cancel Yes leaves isCancelButton true, so completed worker chain can remain in unbounded100ms createReturnValue recursion even after controller menu return.
General communication end is promise-chain ordered, not a universal finally; unexpected rejection can bypass it.
